scores.evidence_span: [Waterbom Bali](https://www.waterbom-bali.com/) [14], with adults supervising separately where rides have age or height restrictions.
scores.rationale: Names a child activity and identifies verifiable age or height restrictions relevant to choosing appropriate rides.

scores.evidence_span: Sanur is preferable to Kuta for this family because it is quieter, easier to walk, less focused on nightlife and has a calmer shoreline.
scores.rationale: Explicitly contrasts family-oriented Sanur with nightlife-oriented Kuta. However, the difference concerns general destination atmosphere rather than explicitly contrasting age-appropriate child activities with an adult-only itinerary; the generic cap applies.

scores.evidence_span: do not replace this with a Nusa Penida speedboat day. The boat journey, sea variability, road conditions and long excursion structure are poor matches for a restful trip with a five-year-old.
scores.rationale: Excludes a named excursion because its structure and conditions are unsuitable for a young child, making age-appropriate activity fit consequential to the recommendation.

scores.evidence_span: Sanur offers the best balance of weather reliability, warm and relatively sheltered water, family accommodation, dining convenience, age-appropriate activities and adequate downtime
scores.rationale: The final recommendation explicitly includes age-appropriate activities as a benefit and does not justify the selected destination through an opposing adult-only preference.
